description: FloodHelpNY is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by New York Office of Resilient Homes and Communities; Center for New York City Neighborhoods, Inc.. This site offers New Yorkers information about flood risk at their address. User can also learn about flood insurance, flood retrofits, and other flood-related topics. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Critical Facilities, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
